concerns.text: Silent relaxation of FR-002 and FR-004. The spec requires the system to 'administer the SART and Ospan cognitive tasks via a web interface' (FR-002) and 'provide a daily logging interface' (FR-004). The tasks only implement scoring and analysis pipelines, completely omitting the development and deployment of the required user interfaces.

Semantic weakening of FR-009. FR-009 requires a 'pre-study pilot check (n=5)' to validate that 'response times are within expected ranges (100ms - 5000ms)'. T003 replaces this with a 'deterministic seeded study simulation', which cannot validate human-interface latency or the actual functionality of the (missing) web interface.

Violation of Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy). The constitution mandates that 'Every external citation... MUST be verified by the Reference-Validator Agent'. T008 and T010 produce reports containing citations and methodological summaries, but no task is included to execute the Reference-Validator Agent gate.

Dropped acceptance criterion from US-1 Scenario 2. The spec requires that if a participant attempts to skip a task, they are 'blocked from proceeding to the intervention phase'. No task implements this blocking logic or the associated data validation.
